2008.what: Passing touchdowns cut from 6 points to 4
Rushing yards moved to 0.1 a yard, 10 yards per point
Receiving yards moved to 0.1 a yard, 10 yards per point

2010.what: Waivers turned off entirely, from a one-day wait
Missed field goals inside 20 yards set to -1

2012.what: Playoff seeding changed: division winners now take the top seeds, instead of every team being seeded by overall record
Trade deadline pushed from 16 to 30 November

2013.what: Interceptions and fumbles lost both doubled, -1 to -2
Fractional points switched on. Every score before 2013 is a whole number

2017.what: Trade deadline pushed from 11 to 25 November
Time to reject a trade cut from two days to one
The Buzz Aldrin's removed from the league

2018.what: Trade review moved from a league vote to the commissioner
Defensive yards allowed started scoring, from 5 points for under 100 down to -3 for 500 or more
Waivers moved to a continual rolling list, from reverse order of standings
Trade deadline pushed from 10 to 24 November
Receptions started counting half a point each, having been worth nothing in every season before this
Field goals flattened: 40-49 and 50+ both cut to 3 points

2020.what: An IR slot added to the roster
Draft moved from offline to live, and time per pick doubled to 2 minutes

note:
Yahoo-era league history that lived nowhere until 2026-11-16.

Read by hand off Yahoo's own pages, signed in as T.J., on 2026-11-16:
  ACTIVITY  football.fantasysports.yahoo.com/{year}/f1/{id}/teams  (the Managers
            page) - waiver priority, moves, trades and, from 2014, FAAB budget left.
  SETTINGS  the same league's home page, Commish Updates, expanded via Show More.

Two limits, stated rather than hidden:
  * Yahoo labels the settings box "no RECENT commissioner changes" when empty, so an
    empty season (2015, 2019) may mean the log aged out, not that nothing changed.
    Treat SETTINGS as what Yahoo still shows, not as a complete history.
  * 2014's log is nothing but Money Paid / Money Owed rows for the $50 buy-in. Those
    are other people's financial details and the site is a public URL, so they are
    deliberately NOT here. Only the buy-in amount itself is recorded, as a league fact.

Rows are keyed by Yahoo TEAM NAME, which is unique within a season. The build joins
them to handles through history.json's team_names, the same way the vetoed trades do.

Run this file to regenerate _yahoo_league_history.json.
